title: Apple expected to require '27 SDKs for App Store Connect submissions
summary: Apple's own developer news page states that starting April 2027, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect must be built with the iOS 27/iPadOS 27 SDK or later (equivalent requirements for tvOS, visionOS and watchOS 27); the rule was posted to developer.apple.com/news/ on September 9, 2026.

sources.title: Apple Sets an April 2027 SDK Deadline for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS and watchOS
iPhone Duo Ships in October. Apple's Next App Rule Waits Until April 2027

title: Apple requires iOS/iPadOS 27 SDK for new App Store submissions
summary: Starting in April 2027, Apple will require App Store Connect uploads to meet minimum SDK versions, with iOS and iPadOS apps needing the iOS 27/iPadOS 27 SDK or newer, and tvOS, visionOS and watchOS apps needing their respective version-27 SDKs.

title: Deno Deploy expected to shut down following Cloudflare acquisition
summary: Cloudflare acquired the Deno team on October 9, 2026 to bolster its Workers platform; independent reporting on the deal consistently states Deno Deploy will shut down roughly six months later, with paying customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers, while the standalone Deno runtime gets about one more year of security fixes before development winds down.

sources.title: Cloudflare Acquires Deno, Ryan Dahl's Team Pivots to Self-Hosted Workers Runtime
Cloudflare has acquired Deno and will use it to boost Workers

title: Docker Hub Automated Builds removed
summary: Docker Hub's Automated Builds feature, which built images from an external source repository and pushed them automatically, is deprecated and will be removed on April 1, 2027.

title: Meta's next mixed-reality headset expected to launch
summary: Meta's next VR/mixed-reality headset from the Connect 2026 lineup is expected to launch in spring 2027 at a reported $1,299.99 price point.

sources.title: Meta Connect 2026 Unveils Lightweight VR Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio and Next-Gen Specs

title: Node.js moves to one major release per year, starting with Node.js 27
summary: Starting with Node.js 27 in April 2027, Node.js shifts from its even/odd LTS cadence to one major release per year, with every release becoming LTS after an October promotion and 36 months of total support.

title: Qualcomm-Apple global patent license renewal takes effect
summary: Qualcomm announced on September 25, 2026 that its global patent license agreement with Apple has been renewed, effective April 1, 2027; financial terms and the new term length were not disclosed.

sources.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) announced the renewal of its global patent license agreement with Apple, effective April 1, 2027
Apple and Qualcomm renew global patent licensing agreement

summary: RSAC Conference returns to the Moscone Center in San Francisco, with College Day held on the closing day.

title: Google Kubernetes Engine 1.35 reaches end of life
summary: Google Kubernetes Engine minor version 1.35 reaches end of life on April 11, 2027, after which Google stops releasing patches for clusters still on that version.

title: Cloud SQL blocks new SQL Server 2017 instances
summary: Google Cloud will stop allowing creation of new Cloud SQL for SQL Server 2017 instances starting April 12, 2027, ahead of SQL Server 2017's own extended-support end date of October 13, 2027.

title: Google Cloud Next 2027
summary: Google's official Cloud Next event FAQ confirms the 2027 conference will run April 13-15, 2027 at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas.

sources.title: Google Cloud Next 2027 - Dates, Registration & 2026 Recap
Google Cloud Next 2027: Dates, Speakers & Registration

title: Mozilla removes trust from 2008-2009 era root CA certificates
summary: Mozilla's root program lifecycle schedule removes the website (TLS) trust bit from root CA certificates whose key material dates to 2008-2009 on April 15, 2027, forcing affected CAs (including some legacy Sectigo and SECOM roots) to have migrated to newer roots beforehand.

sources.title: Remove Website and Email Trust Bit from "Security Communication RootCA2"

title: Mozilla/Chrome to distrust legacy Sectigo COMODO/USERTrust roots
summary: Mozilla's root store (and Chrome) will remove the Websites trust bit from Sectigo's legacy COMODO ECC, COMODO RSA, USERTrust ECC and USERTrust RSA roots on April 15, 2027, per Sectigo's filed transition plan in Mozilla's bug tracker; email trust for these roots is removed later, in 2030.

sources.title: Changes to Root CA hierarchies and trust status

title: Claude Opus 4.7 drops out of guaranteed support
summary: Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists Claude Opus 4.7 with an earliest-possible retirement date of April 16, 2027 on Anthropic-operated platforms (Claude API, Claude on AWS, Microsoft Foundry).

title: GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines remove the Ubuntu 22.04 hosted runner image
summary: The ubuntu-22.04 hosted runner image, shared by GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines and in deprecation brownouts since September 17, 2026, is fully removed on April 17, 2027, after which jobs requesting it fail with a hard error.

sources.title: GitHub Actions Runner Images Ubuntu 22.04 Arm64 - Version Status

title: ICLR 2027
summary: The International Conference on Learning Representations lists its main conference for April 26-28, 2027 with workshops April 28-30, 2027 on the official ICLR site; the host city is still marked TBA.

title: ICLR 2027
summary: ICLR's official site lists the 2027 main conference for April 26-28, with workshops running April 28-30; the host venue was not yet officially confirmed as of this sweep.

title: AWS Lambda deprecates the nodejs22.x runtime
summary: AWS Lambda ends support for the nodejs22.x managed runtime in line with Node.js 22's community LTS end date; new function creation and updates on that runtime stop after this date.

title: Node.js 22 reaches end-of-life
summary: Node.js 22 ("Jod") stops receiving all support, including security updates, on this date.
